page: OVHcloud l40s-90 is a GPU-accelerated cloud instance within the Cloud GPU family, provisioned via KVM virtualization. The instance features 15 dedicated physical cores of an AMD EPYC 9124 processor running at a base clock speed of 2.75 GHz on the x86_64 architecture. Hardware multithreading is disabled, allotting one thread per core across 15 vCPUs. The CPU subsystem is backed by 64 KB of L1 data cache, 0.5 MB of L2 cache, and 16 MB of L3 cache, with hardware instruction support for AVX-512 vector extensions including VNNI and BF16.

Hardware acceleration is powered by a single NVIDIA L40S GPU from the Ada Lovelace architecture, equipped with 48 GB of dedicated VRAM. The system provides 90 GB of system memory, matching a ratio of 6 GB RAM per dedicated vCPU core. Local storage is bundled as a 400 GB NVMe SSD, and the instance attaches to the network via an 8 Gbps baseline bandwidth connection.

Benchmark results demonstrate top-tier execution in deep learning inference tasks. The NVIDIA L40S accelerator places the server in the top 10 percent for large language model inference across 135M, 7B, and 70B parameter models, generating 605.12 tokens per second on 135M models and 15.72 tokens per second on 70B models. Prompt processing throughput reaches 6030.41 tokens per second on 7B architectures and 13644.94 tokens per second on 135M models. In contrast, CPU and general-purpose memory workloads operate in the middle 50 percent tier, with a PassMark CPU score of 34459.04, a Geekbench multi-core score of 11588.0, and a large-block uncached read memory bandwidth of 49.41 GB/s. Stress-ng single-core compute performance measures in the top 25 percent at 3043.17.

The hardware configuration provides high compute and memory density for artificial intelligence operations relative to standard CPU instances. The 400 GB NVMe storage footprint is compact, making the host best suited for model serving, generative AI pipelines, ray tracing, and batch inference workflows rather than data-lake hosting or persistent high-capacity storage.
description: OVHcloud l40s-90 is a GPU-focused cloud compute instance tailored for artificial intelligence and compute workloads. Hosted on the KVM hypervisor, it is configured with 15 dedicated cores of an AMD EPYC 9124 processor running at 2.75 GHz, accompanied by 90 GB of RAM. Accelerated compute is handled by an NVIDIA Ada Lovelace L40S graphics card with 48 GB of VRAM. The instance includes a 400 GB local NVMe SSD and maintains an 8 Gbps network baseline. Performance benchmarks highlight top-tier capabilities in large language model inference across small, medium, and large architectures, while CPU compute and memory throughput deliver balanced mid-tier results. Due to the high-density GPU acceleration and dedicated core allocation, the server is suitable for generative AI inference, batch neural network evaluation, ray tracing, and specialized machine learning workloads.
